paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved -1.15% on average, with Dow Jones strongest (+1.60%) and Nikkei 225 weakest (-4.64%). Brent crude changed +3.96% to 110.26. Gold changed +0.60% to 4,132.5. Bitcoin changed +0.74% to 82,749.1172. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.117%, a relative move of -1.92%. Among the firms tracked, Bank of America (-6.15%) and BlackRock (+5.87%) moved the most.
